Name: Fashion Sense Wheelchair Mod (beta)
Author: shadeinthestars
Description:
Very beta, only have the front sprites at the moment. Saw someone on tumblr complaining that there were no wheelchair mods for Stardew Valley, so I decided I would try and fix that. I am not a wheelchair user and have only basic modding skills but I hope that I have done an OK job. The Wheelchair is under Pants, the shoes don't change colour unless you use the recolourable Shoes item, and the arms don't move properly unless you use the Sleeves item.

Known Issues:
- Character bobs while moving
- Footstep sounds while character moves

If anybody knows how to fix this please let me know!
